༄༅/ /rdo rje khyung khra dang nā ga rakṣa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje khyung khra dang nā ga rakṣa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so//

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// rtsod dus 'dir klu dang sa bdag gi 'tshe ba mang zhing sems can blo dman rnams kyi don du/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i rdo rje khyung khra dang*/ rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga rakṣa slob dpon padma'i lugs dang ku sā li'i lugs dpa' bo rkyang sgrub gnyis sgrub thabs kyi yan lag dang rjes gnang dkyus gcig gis sgrub pa'i thabs shin tu bsdus pa ni/ gnas dben par lha gang sgrub pa'i bris sku'i mdun du dkar gtor dang mchod pa bshams/ sgrub pa po sha chang sogs kha na ma tho ba'i bza' btung spangs la stan bde bar 'dug ste/ sngon 'gro skyabs sems/ gzhi bdag bgegs la gtor ma btang*/ mchod pa/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos| mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shapada'i bar sbyar la byin gyis brlabs/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar gsum dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sogs tshangs gnas bzhi bsgoms/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba dra ba gur bla bre mda'i dra ba phyi rol du ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ khyung khra byed na/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su paṃ las padma/ aḥlas zla ba/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i gdan la/ rang sems kṣiṃ kha dog lnga ldan gyi 'od 'bar ba las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje khyung khra dus kyi 'khor lo'i ngo bor gyur pa 'dab chags kyi rgyal po chen po rkang mthil nas dpyi yi bar sa'i rang bzhin ser po/

dpyi nas lte ba'i bar chu'i rang bzhin dkar po/ lte ba nas mgrin pa'i bar me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ mgrin pa nas smin ma'i bar nam mkha'i rang bzhin nag po/ smin ma nas spyi bo'i bar rlung gi rang bzhin ljang gu/ spyan gsum smin ma ag tshom sma ra me ltar 'bar zhing*| rdo rje'i mchu sder can/ klu rgyal ba ljang gu dang rnam rgyal sngon pos dbu skra bcings pa/ stobs rgyu dang padma nag pos snyan cha/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar pos phyag gdub/ 'jog po dang padma chen pos zhabs gdub/ mtha' yas dkar pos ska rags/ rigs ldan dkar pos mgul rgyan byas pa/ rdo rje'i rwa sprag tu klu'i rgyal po'i spyi bo nas phrogs pa'i nor bus spras pa/ rdo rje'i gshog pa gnyis kyi rgyab nag po/ mdun dkar po/ bar dmar po/ tha ma ye shes kyi rang bzhin sngon po/ phrag gong dang rgyab tu sprin kha dog sna tshogs pa 'khrugs pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis klu ma rungs pa tshar gcod pa/ g.yon thugs kar skyabs sbyin gyis klu rnams rjes su 'dzin pa/ de gnyis kas klu gdug pa can bzung ba'i mgo bo zhal du bcug pa/ zhabs gnyis tsog pus klu dang sa bdag ma rungs pa'i steng du bro rdung zhing sku las 'od lnga 'bar zhing 'phro ba/ de'i lte bar sa dkyil la laṃ| snying khar chu dkyil la u/ mgrin par me dkyil la raṃ/ dpral bar rlung dkyil la e/ gtsug tor du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la u rnams kyis mtshan par gyur par bsam/ yang nā ga rakṣa byed na/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su klu dang sa bdag gis gang ba'i rgya mtsho chen po gting mtha' med pa'i dbus su phe sha na ga du bhrūṃ zhes pa'i sprul pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po'i dbus su klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong bsnol ba'i steng du/ rang rig phe las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga rakṣa dpa' bo rkyang pa/

sku mdog rdo stang zil ltar gnag pa/ rtsa zhal srin po khros pa lta bu spyan gsum smin ma dang ag tshom 'bar zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ sbrul mgo dgu dang ldan pa'i sbrul mgo dbus mar rin po che'i prog zhu gsol ba/ phyag g.yas pa brgyad kyis gri gug /g.yon pa brgyad sbrul zhags thogs pa/ klu rgyal rigs kyi mgul chu/ rje rigs kyi dpung rgyan/ bram ze'i rigs kyi phyag gdub/ dmangs rigs kyi ska rags/ gdol ba gdan du bting ba/ sku smad sbrul mjug rgya mtshor 'khyil ba/ bā su rigs drug zas su za zhing dbu gzengs bstod de bar snang la 'phyo ba/ zhal nas i sha'i sgra sgrog pa/ sku la ye shes lnga'i me 'bar bar bsgom mo// de gnyis gang byed kyang thun mong du/ de ltar gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams gsal ba las 'od 'phros pas ye shes pa dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha bdud rtsis bum pa gang ba bsnams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod pa ni khyung khra la/ gang gi sngags dang phyag rgya bka' stsal gyis// klu rgyal 'khor bcas bran du bskol mdzad cing*// rigs lnga'i rang bzhin kha dog lnga ldan pa// 'dab chags mgon po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces dang*/ nā ga rakṣa la/ 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das mtshams shed na// rgyal mtsho chen po'i klong yangs dwangs pa'i nang*// bskal pa sbrul nag 'khyil ba'i klong yangs nas// rig pa'i rgyal po 'chi bdag mgo dgu pa// bdud kyi bdud de 'chi bdag klu yi bdud// 'jam dpal thugs sprul khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/

bzlas pa ni khyung khra la/ rang gi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su kṣiṃ 'od lnga 'bar ba'i mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa zhi bar byas/ klu gnyan sa bdag thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi nas bde la bkod/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs bsdus nas rang la thim zhing*/ nyi dkyil sa bon gnyis mi 'gul bar sngags phreng drag la myur bar g.yas su 'khor bar bsam pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ pakṣiṃ swā hā/ zhes 'bum phrag lnga/ rtags ni rmi lam du nyi zla shar ba dang*/ me tog 'thu ba/ rgya mtshor rkang lag rkyong ba/ sbal sbrul lcong mo zos pa sogs rming*/ dngos su sa g.yo ba dang*/ khang par tshag sgra dang*/ lus la me 'bar ba sogs 'byung*/ sngags grangs thems kyang rtags med na/ sngags bye ba gcig bzlas pas ni sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad bran bzhin bkol ba dang*/ mkha' lding gi phyag rgya byas pa tsam dang*/ sngags bzlas pa tsam gyis sa bdag klu gnyan 'byung po thams cad tshar gcod nus pa nges par 'byung ngo*// nā ga rakṣa'i bzlas pa ni/ rang gi thugs kar ye shes sems dpa'i sbrul nag po nas tsam zhig 'khyil ba'i snying khar nyi ma yungs 'bru phyed bshags tsam gyi dbus su phe sngo nag spus bris pa tsam gyi mthar yi ge bzhi pa las 'od 'phros/ sa bdag klu'i dug la phog pas thams cad rang zhir gyur/ 'od des gnod byed la reg pas gnod byed de sdug bsngal thams cad zhi nas 'od lnga rang sang la song bar bsam pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ phe laṃ hūm̐/ zhes pa 'bum phrag bzhi bzla'o// rtags ni klu'i rigs kyi srog chags bsad pa dang zos pa/ lus kyi sgo nas sbal sbrul lam srog chags thon pa sogs dang*/ rgyud las/ stong nyid sems gsal ting 'dzin rtags// shes pa rngam la dbang po gsal// bde ba'i ye shes rgyud la 'char| |ye shes 'khor lo de nyid do// rtags ni phyag rgya gsal ba ste// na kra mgul 'phrig rkang khol dang*// shu thor sha ro byung ba na// lus la gsang ba rgyas thebs pas// dus gsum rgyun gyi kha ching yin// zhes gsungs so// sngags 'bum phrag lnga la rtags ma byung na bye ba gcig bzla/

de la rtags ma byung na sngags ring ba ni/ oṃ nag po ti pa ra tsa ya nā ga rakṣa oṃ phe laṃ hūm̐/ zhes yi ge bcu gnyis pa la 'bum phrag gcig bzla'o// 'on kyang rtags yi ge bzhi pa nyid gsal/ mthar rdzogs rim ni/ lha gnyis gang yin yang*/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros brtan g.yo snod bcud la phog pas 'od du zhu ba rang nyid la thim zhing*/ rang gi lus stod smad nas 'od du zhu ba thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/ sa bon 'od 'bar bas stong gsum 'od du 'bar bar gyur par sems gtad/ mthar dmigs med kyis rgyas gdab/ slar skad cig gis lha gang yin de nyid lam gyis ldang bar bya'o// khyung khra dang nā ga rakṣa gnyis gang yin yang thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma chus sbyangs/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pas gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum brjod/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis gtor mgron rdo rje khyung khra'am/ rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga rakṣa la sangs rgyas dang byang sems tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ padma ka ma lā ye st+waṃ/ a ti pū hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ zhes dang*/ lha rnams kyi ljags 'od kyis rdo rje sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bas mnyes shing tshim par bsam la/ oṃ pakṣiṃ badzra bi shwa ga ru ḍa/ zhes dang*/ nā ga rakṣa la/ oṃ nag po ti pa ra tsa ya nā ga rakṣa/ zhes dang*/ de gnyis gang byed kyi sngags sham du/ sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ nyer gcig dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// bar gyis 'dod don gsol/ sngar ltar mchod cing bstod nas yig brgya lan gsum gyis nongs bshags la/

badzra muḥ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam la rgyun spyod la 'jug /thun mtshams su klu gtor yang btang ngo*// de ni sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /slob ma rjes su 'dzin na/ me tog gi tshom bu'i dbus su/ bum pa chu dang bum rdzas nyer lngas bkang ba'i kha rgyan gyi khrod du bris sku gzhug /gzung thag btags/ thod pa mtshan ldan chang gis bkang ba la rdo rje rtse lnga pa lung thang gi bgrang phreng sogs 'du bya/ mchod gtor dang mchod pa bshams/ bdag bskyed gong ltar grub rjes/ bum dbang dang*/ maṇḍal tshom bu yang bdag bskyed ltar gdon pa spos la bskyed/ sngags ci 'grub bzla/ gtor ma gong ltar 'bul/ bum pa bzhugs/ bdag 'jug blangs/ slob ma 'khyil pa bzlas pa'i chus khrus bya/ gral du bkod/ bgegs bskrad/ maṇḍal 'bul/ klu nad kyi dogs pa yod na dbang gi don du klu gtor tshar gcig slob dpon dang slob mas lhan du btang*/ dogs pa med na mi dgos so// kun mkhyen ye shes tshar gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs rgyun bshags gsum bya/ rdo rje mgor bzhag /dam chu khar sbyin zhing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub 'byung*// dam las 'gal na sreg par byed// rdo rje'i dam las ma 'da' zhig /pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha/ zhes sbyin/ slob ma'i snying khar kun rdzob byang sems kyi ngo bo zla ba nya gang ba'i dbus su don dam byang sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje rtse lnga pa gcig gsal btab pas/ slob mas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpā da yā mi/ zhes sems bskyed/ de nyid brtan phyir bla mas slob ma'i snying khar rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa bzhag la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥ siddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod la/ lha gang yin gyi mngon rtogs bsgom du bcug la/

ye shes pa dbab/ rdo rje rgya gram spyi bor bzhag la/ tiṣṭha badzra gyis brtan par bya/ dngos gzhi dbang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob mas/ bcom ldan rdo rje khyung khra ni// zhes sam/ bcom ldan rig pa'i rgyal po ni// zhes dang*/ thun mong du/ sku gsung thugs mchog 'od zer can// gdug pa ma rungs 'dul ba'i phyir// sku gsung thugs dbang stsal du gsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bris sku slob ma'i mgor bzhag la/ hūm̐ */ lus la rdo rje'i sku dbang sbyin// bu khyod lus sgrib kun dag cing*// nad gdon bgegs las rab grol nas// rdo rje'i sku mchog thob par shog /lha sngags mthar/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ btags pas bskur/ brtan phyir bum pa'i chu dbang kho bos byas pa'i sgrub thabs nor bu phreng ba'i rjes gnang gi chu dbang ltar bskur/ rigs lngas rgyas btab/ des sku'i dbang thob/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag /bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ sprul sku thob pa'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag par bsam| thod pa'i bdud rtsi mgrin par bzhag /hūm̐ */ ngag la rdo rje'i gsung dbang sbyin// bu khyod ngag sgrib kun dag cing*// nad gdon bgegs las rab grol nas// rdo rje'i gsung mchog thob par shog /lha sngags mthar/ wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ brtan phyir phreng ba gtad la/ slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa spros/ zhal nas thon/ slob ma lhar gsal ba'i rna ba gnyis nas brgyud snying khar 'khor bar bsam zhing*/ sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ des gsung gi dbang thob/ ngag sgrib dag /sngags bzla ba la dbang*| longs sku thob pa'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /rdo rje rtse lnga snying khar gtad la/ hūm̐ */ sems la rdo rje'i thugs dbang sbyin// bu khyod yid sgrib kun dag cing*// nad gdon bgegs las rab grol nas// rdo rje'i thugs mchog thob par shog

/sngags mthar/ tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ brtan phyir me tog 'thor zhing*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ des thugs kyi dbang thob/ yid sgrib dag /rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang*| |chos sku thob pa'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /mtha' brten ni/ rdor dril slob ma'i mgor bzhag la/ hūm̐ */ nga ni rdo rje khyung khra ste// zhes sam/ nga ni rig pa'i rgyal po ste// de ring rdo rje'i slob ma la// rdo rje bdag po'i dbang sbyin gyi// lha bsgom sngags bzla chos nyid bsam// phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub pa dang*// sems can don rnams bsgrub par bgyi/ */ sngags mthar/ sarba siddhi pha la a bhi sogs btags pas sbyin/ me tog 'thor zhing*/ hoḥ bcom ldan rdo rje khyung khra yi// zhes sam/ rig pa'i rgyal po yi/ */sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi// bden pa mchog gi bkra shis gang*// des khyod deng nas dge gyur cig /ces sbyar/ ye dharma brjod/ des rdo rje'i bdag por dbang bskur thob pas/ deng nas bzung ste lha chen po sgom sgrub sngags bzla/ mchod cing dbang bskur sogs phrin las sgrub pa'i rim pa thams cad la dbang bar byas pa yin no// zhes dang*/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// sogs dam tshig bsdus te khas blangs| gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ bum mdun gyi lha la mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ gshegs bsdu/ bsngo smon/ shis brjod bya zhing las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// smras pa/ tshad pa'i nad la ga pur bzhin// sa klu gnyen po 'di kho na// rtsod dus 'gro rnams bya byed tshogs// mang bas sa klus gtses mthong bas// de yi gnyen por 'di byas pas// lhag pa'i byang chub rgyu ru bsngo// zhes pa'ang sa bdag klu gnyan gyis gtses pa'i gnyen po sems can blo dman dag gis bsnyen sgrub rgya che bar 'jug pa mi spob pa'i phyir/

de rnams la phan pa'i brtse sems rnam par dkar bas mtshams sbyar te/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas sa stag nag pa can gyi phyogs phyi ma'i dga' ba gnyis par 'bri chos phyug klung gi pho brang lcang lo can rdo rje theg pa'i gan mdzod du bris pa'o/// / ༈ /khyung khra'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ rin chen 'od/ grags rgyal/ kun rgyal/ 'phags pa/ zhang kun dpal/ nam brag /bsod rgyan/ gzung dpal/ ā nanta pa/ sa bzang*/ bsam brtse ba/ chos 'phel ba/ nam bsod pa/ dpal 'byor/ chos dbang rin ched/ bla ma dā' na sampānna/ ༈ /nā ga rakṣa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub dbang*/ shā ri'i bu/ klu sgrub/ hūm̐ ka ra/ slob dpon padma/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ rgya zhang khrom/ gu ru chos dbang*/ sras pad dbang*/ dbus pa grags 'bum/ grub chen dpal seng*/ 'jam dbyangs brtson mgon/ grub chen rin rdor/ grub chen rin grub/ rje bkra shis bzang*/ sprul sku pad dbang*/ rig 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje/ rgyal dbang gnam lcags me 'bar/ mtshungs med chos rgyal phun tshogs/ des bdag rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa la'o// //sarba maṅgalaṃ//
